purpose: Current optional password verifier for an Account, isolated from Account and email identity state.

columns.name: password_credential_ref
columns.meaning: Stable identity of the current password credential.

columns.name: verifier
columns.meaning: Argon2id encoded verifier over peppered password material.
columns.value_contract: Argon2id version 19 encoded verifier; raw password/pepper never stored.

columns.name: pepper_key_id
columns.meaning: Non-secret identifier of the external pepper key used for prehashing.
columns.value_contract: Opaque non-empty key identifier; pepper secret remains outside PostgreSQL.

primary_key.name: pk_password_credential
primary_key.reason: Stable credential identity used for stale-authentication revalidation.

foreign_keys.name: fk_password_credential_account_ref_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the current password credential to its Account.

unique_constraints.name: uq_password_credential_account_ref
unique_constraints.reason: Enforce at most one current PasswordCredential per Account.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_credential_verifier_format
check_constraints.reason: Reject verifier rows that are not Argon2id v19 encodings.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_credential_pepper_key_id
check_constraints.reason: Require an explicit non-secret pepper key identifier.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_credential_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND updated_at >= created_at
check_constraints.reason: Keep credential timestamps finite and ordered.

lifecycle.retention: Only the current password credential is represented in M3-A; password history is intentionally not selected.
lifecycle.redaction: Verifier and pepper key id are security-sensitive persistence metadata; raw password and pepper secret are forbidden.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Replacement/removal requires a later security mutation contract; no runtime DELETE in M3-A.

obligations: M3-A real PostgreSQL schema, ACL, mapping and catalog proof
